about.title: About ProustGPT
about.projectDesc1: ProustGPT is an AI-powered tool for exploring Marcel Proust's In Search of Lost Time through conversation. It combines intelligent passage retrieval with reflective dialogue, inviting you to engage with one of the greatest works of literature in a new way.
about.projectDesc2: Whether you are a first-time reader seeking guidance or a devoted Proustian revisiting familiar passages, ProustGPT meets you where you are and helps you discover connections, themes, and moments you may have missed.
about.proustDesc1: Marcel Proust (1871–1922) spent much of his life writing In Search of Lost Time, a novel published in seven volumes spanning roughly 3,000 pages. It is widely regarded as one of the most significant works of modern literature.
about.proustDesc2: The novel traces the narrator's journey through memory, time, art, and love — from childhood days in the village of Combray to the salons of Parisian high society. Its most famous passage, the madeleine dipped in tea, captures the power of involuntary memory to collapse the distance between past and present.
about.exploreLostTime: Explore Lost Time — Ask a question or name a theme, and ProustGPT searches through the full text to find relevant passages. It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground every response in Proust's own words.
about.reflectOnMyDay: Reflect on My Day — Describe a moment from your life, and ProustGPT responds in the introspective, layered style of Proust himself, drawing connections between your experience and the themes of the novel.
about.bilingualDesc: Every chapter can be read side-by-side in Scott Moncrieff's English and Proust's original French. Open any chapter in the Read view and toggle “EN + FR”.
about.translationOriginal: Original title: À la Recherche du Temps Perdu (1913–1927)
about.translationMoncrieff: Translation: C. K. Scott Moncrieff (1889–1930) — vols. 1 to 6
